title: RNA Extraction Using Life Magnetics C-Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: RPS wash, remove supernatant in samples
Two ethanol washes, remove supernatant in samples
Dispense in temperature module (well to well transfer).

steps.title: Configure tip rack usage
steps.instruction: Select whether to reset tip racks: choose “yes” to pick up tips from well A1 on both the 200 µL and 300 µL tip racks, or “no” to continue from the last used tip position.

steps.title: Set aspiration geometry
steps.instruction: Define the supernatant aspiration height (mm) measured from the bottom of the well, and set the lateral distance from the side opposite the magnetically engaged beads (mm) – 1 mm corresponds to the well side, 4.1 mm to the well centre.

steps.title: Mount P300 pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 Single‑GEN2 pipette on the chosen mount side (left or right) of the robot.

steps.title: Engage modules and reach temperature
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and heat the temperature module until the set temperature is reached (temperature value as programmed).

steps.title: Add binding buffer and mix (normal mode)
steps.instruction: When the temperature is reached, add the binding buffer to each sample, mix thoroughly, then aspirate and discard 200 µL of supernatant.

steps.title: Remove storage buffer (wastewater mode)
steps.instruction: If operating in wastewater mode, aspirate and discard up to 1.5 mL of storage buffer from each sample.

steps.title: RPS wash and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Perform the RPS wash on each sample, then aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Carry out two successive ethanol washes on each sample, removing the supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Remove residual liquid
steps.instruction: Allow the samples to settle and dry, then aspirate and discard 300 µL from each sample well.

steps.title: Elution volume aspiration and mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate the designated elution volume from each sample and mix to resuspend the RNA.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to temperature module
steps.instruction: Dispense the eluate from each sample well to the corresponding well on the temperature module (well‑to‑well transfer).

steps.title: Mix and incubate three times
steps.instruction: Mix the transferred eluate and incubate; repeat the mix‑incubate cycle three times.

steps.title: Transfer to magnetic module and engage magnet
steps.instruction: Dispense the eluate from the temperature module to the magnetic module (well‑to‑well transfer) and engage the magnet.

steps.title: Final volume transfer
steps.instruction: Move the final volume from each well to the next column or to each triplicate well on the magnetic deck (well‑to‑well transfer).
